reason: Cloud-copy collections (Callum's 2026-10-06 decision) are one feature module: service-created (account session, hosted first member), owner-device creation, and owner-device join, all through registerNextCollection/queueNextPolicy, the existing challenge table and the C1 service-device client. Exports are the route registrar and the two device-proof digests. No new transport or credential store; app.ts mounts it only with MDBASE_NEXT_CLOUD_COPY_BOOTSTRAP=1.
